correctness.rationale: Independent computation rebuilt the 20-vertex GP(10,3) graph, enumerated all 6212 augmented independent faces with the exact cardinality distribution, recreated the supplied stage-order matching (3103 disjoint pairs), checked six critical augmented faces (one dimension-4 and five dimension-5), oriented and topologically sorted all 30380 Hasse incidences, and recomputed the five signed integral Morse attaching-degree coefficients as 0. The empty face is paired to a vertex, yielding one ordinary critical 0-cell; Forman acyclic matching yields a CW complex with 0,4,5-cells only. The 4-skeleton is S^4 and π4(S^4)≈Z classifies 5-cell attachments by degree; degree zeros give S^4∨⋁^5 S^5. A separately written GF(2) boundary reduction produced ranks [1,19,141,519,991,932,383,97,18,2] and reduced Betti numbers H4=1,H5=5. The finite exhaustive proof suffices for one finite graph; neither stored VERIFY_OK nor sample tests were assumed as proof.
